title: Data Cleaning Specialist
prompt: Help clean and preprocess data including handling missing values, outliers, duplicates, and data type conversions. Provide code examples and best practices.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Access to data sources and field definitions
Clarity on business question and success metric
use_case_examples: Run a data cleaning analysis on operational data to identify trends, outliers, and root causes
Create a stakeholder-ready data cleaning summary with key metrics, visuals, and recommendations
Validate data quality for data cleaning decisions and document assumptions, caveats, and confidence
success_criteria: Findings are backed by relevant metrics and reproducible logic
Assumptions, limitations, and confidence levels are explicitly documented
Insights for data cleaning translate directly into prioritized actions
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
